name: Mountain-Bracing Bolt
passiveDesc: Decreases Climbing Stamina Consumption by 15% and increases Elemental Skill DMG by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24%. Also, after other nearby party members use Elemental Skills, the equipping character's Elemental Skill DMG will also increase by 12%/15%/18%/21%/24% for 8s.
description: This polearm was once jointly forged by the craftsmen in the mines as a sacrifice to the spirits of the mountains.
